trigger.observed_failure: The frozen one-year caches are contiguous but contain explicitly labeled hl_gap_fill continuity rows in addition to native hl candles.

corrected_source_contract.hl_gap_fill_definition: Deterministic zero-volume continuity row carrying the preceding native Hyperliquid close across a bounded minute absent from the venue candle dataset.
corrected_source_contract.required_grid: Exactly one unique ordered row per minute from 2025-07-28T00:00:00Z through 2026-07-28T00:00:00Z exclusive.
corrected_source_contract.provenance_reporting: Publish native count, continuity-fill count, and maximum continuity-fill run for every symbol.
corrected_source_contract.decision_treatment: Continuity rows retain the preceding venue close and participate in completed-hour clock continuity; they cannot introduce a new high, low, return, or stop crossing by themselves.
corrected_source_contract.limitation: A continuity row is not an observed trade candle. Results therefore remain bar-model evidence and cannot establish exact within-gap mark-trigger ordering.

falsifiers: Any symbol contains a source other than hl or hl_gap_fill.
Any gap-fill run exceeds thirty minutes.
Any cache is not the exact contiguous unique one-year grid.
Any published result omits the per-symbol source counts and maximum gap-fill run.
Any economic or signal parameter changed after the source validation failure.
